about_the_game:
Only Up: CHAINED is an online multiplayer parkour game where you and your friends must climb obstacles and avoid falling at all costs, one wrong move and it could be back to the start. Experience hundreds of unique obstacles inspired by different cultures of the world. Don't get too excited just yet, getting to the top might be one of the must painful experiences of your life. 

Features:

  • Online multiplayer, raging is better with friends.

  • Physics-based chain, simulating a realistic chain

  • Cool mechanics, climbing, mantling and pushing.

  • Community Support, we will be actively monitoring our discord to help you!

  • Seasonal Leaderboards
